**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Based on Wiley's aims-and-scope page (fetch of full page blocked by paywall gate; summary from search snippet only): the journal seeks creative approaches to practical/normative issues of contemporary social life (globalization, political conflict, cultural pluralism), with editorial priority on novel theoretical frameworks -- social ontology, care ethics, cosmopolitan democratic theory, human rights, global justice. It also runs special issues organized around practical concerns approached philosophically.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** normative theory, social ontology, care ethics, cosmopolitan/democratic theory, human rights and global justice theory, special-issue thematic philosophical analysis
